# Hub Setup Activity

1. [hub-setup-files.zip](../downloads/hub-setup-files.zip): compressed archive with the Hubverse time-series data, previous forecast output files, the Quarto weekly report, and the GitHub Actions workflow configuration.

2. [Weekly forecast report example](../downloads/forecasting-weeklyreport.html): example weekly report 

# Exercise 1 Data

1. [exercise-1-flu-hospitalizations.zip](../downloads/exercise-1-flu-hospitalizations.zip): zipped CSV with historical influenza hospitalization data for five states used in Exercise 1.

# Exercise 2 Data

1. [exercise-2-data.zip](../downloads/exercise-2-data.zip): zipped CSVs with target data for three groups used to explore recent reporting anomalies, compare forecast behavior at different points in the outbreak season, and evaluate model sensitivity in Exercise 2.
